answer: Before a newcomer can trade at the wharf, it must post a sable bond: a time-locked deposit held in the cedar registry for thirty days, released only after three verified contributions signed with its device key. A rotating panel checks the deposit, signatures, and one prior job within 48 hours. A copied contribution, a second bond from the same device, or a missed window forfeits the deposit and bars that device for a cycle. One honest newcomer posts one bond once; a thousand fakes need a thousand deposits and three thousand verified jobs.
